name: Kuroi Hamon
source:
Main character hears some sounds at night and comes out. There is an anxious girl at the street. She is worried about something happening at school. Explore the place to reveal its mystery.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公夜里听到一些声音，便走了出来。街上有个焦虑不安的女孩，她担心学校里发生了什么事。探索这片地方，揭开其中的谜团。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
